taskPacket.objective: normalizeCodexResult classifies a disabled code-mode host before a termination signal, and bounded codex diagnostics never exceed 512 UTF-8 bytes.
instructions: In normalizeCodexResult (scripts/drivers/exec-jsonl.mjs), classify a code-mode-host-disabled item error before the termination signal and before any later turn.completed or agent_message: a harness that dies after the host error is a provider failure (tool_host_unavailable), never a cancellation, and still reports the completed turn's usage.
A signal with no tool-host error still cancels.

boundedMessage cuts before the character that starts at the byte ceiling instead of backing up onto a dangling lead byte, so a truncated multibyte diagnostic re-encodes to at most 512 UTF-8 bytes with no U+FFFD.

The CODEX_PREAMBLE_OVERRIDES comment (scripts/drivers/codex.mjs) records all four measured host outcomes: gpt-5.6-sol 35,130 fabricated vs 35,199 correct tool-backed; deepseek-v4-flash 25,795 vs 25,783, both correct.
Regression tests pin the precedence, the byte bound and the measurements.
nonGoals: Changing how other item-level error records (rollout_budget warnings, missing model metadata) are treated: they stay ignored diagnostics.
